messages:
Dani CSM: Quick ask 1 building a 1-page 'chef play' for customer onboarding — tiny steps users can copy into kickoff. Focus: cache/prefill, adaptive batching, streaming fallback, renewal signals. Thoughts?
Omar SE: Love it. Keep language customer-friendly. Include exact numbers for ops teams (TTL, batch sizes, alert thresholds).
Jo DevEx: Agree. Add two copy/paste snippets: 1) prefill curl, 2) smoke healthcheck (PromQL).
Sam PM: Also include a one-line "what we promise" for the customer: expected tail latency and warmup window. Helps to set expectations.
Dani CSM: Drafting now. Short, practical.
Dani CSM: PREFACE FOR AEs (one line to paste): "We'll prefill your top intents and monitor p95 latency; typical warm window is 10 minutes during ramp."
Omar SE: Ops knobs (copy):
- prefill_ttl: 900s (default), up to 1800s for heavy context
- warm_pool: enabled for >500 TPS usecases, burst_pool: 300s
- batch_target_tokens: 1024 for balanced latency/cost, 2048 for throughput
Jo DevEx: Snippet: prefill curl (copy):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-qa-1","intents":["search","summarize"],"ttl":900}'
```
Omar SE: Healthcheck (promql) snippet:
```
sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (route)
/ sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_count[5m])) by (route)
```
Jo DevEx: Add a lightweight client pattern: jitter + retry for short windows, and backoff to non-streaming when stream error >10% in 5m.
Dani CSM: Renewal risk signals (copy):
- sustained p95 > 1s for 24h
- cache hit rate < 40% for 48h
- streaming error rate > 10% for 3 consecutive days
- sudden cost delta > 25% week-over-week
Dani CSM: Playbook for CS when risk triggers:
1) Open triage with SE and infra (24h)
2) Offer to prefill additional intents and enable burst pool (48h)
3) Propose routing to cheaper quantized model with QA gating (72h)
Sam PM: Add AE-friendly email snippet to alert customer proactively.
Dani CSM: AE email (copy): "We've detected increased latency for your top flows. We're enabling extra warm capacity and will monitor for 24 hours. Expect minor token usage increase; we'll share metrics and next steps."
Omar SE: Quick test plan: k6 script with 100 vus, 2m, validate p95 < target and stream success > 98%.
Jo DevEx: Where to store? I'll create /onboarding-templates/chef-playbook-brief.md and link here.
AlertBot: Link created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboarding/chef-playbook-brief
Dani CSM: Perfect. I'll include this in tomorrow's kickoff packet. Thanks all :raised_hands:
